operationalization.era_band_gap: mean R1 residual among DOMINANT solves minus mean R1 residual among NONDOMINANT solves within era
operationalization.early_gap: arithmetic mean of E1 and E2 era-band gaps
operationalization.late_gap: arithmetic mean of E3 and E4 era-band gaps
operationalization.era_sign_match: E1/E2 gap >0 and E3/E4 gap <0, counted era-wise
operationalization.early_late_pooled_residual_difference: mean R1 residual over all early-era solves (E1/E2 pooled) minus mean over all late-era solves (E3/E4 pooled)
operationalization.leave_one_era_sign_invariance: PASS iff all four adequate-support leave-one-era pooled residual means are strictly positive or all four are strictly negative; any exact zero or mixed signs fails
operationalization.method_marginal_gap: CFOP pooled R1 residual minus NONCFOP pooled R1 residual
operationalization.band_marginal_gap: DOMINANT pooled R1 residual minus NONDOMINANT pooled R1 residual

package_logic.MIXED_OR_PARTIAL: no terminal full-package verdict applies and at least one but not all predictions pass in either structured rival
package_logic.NONSTATIONARY_MIXTURE_SUPPORTED: support adequate, neither structured rival package passes, and zero primary predictions pass across both structured rivals
package_logic.SUPPORT_LIMITED: any prediction required for terminal package is non-evaluable under frozen support floors

forbidden: change package logic after fresh96 geometry
redefine zero as favorable sign post hoc
pool prior corpora before fresh terminal verdict
promote causal or cognitive mechanism claims
